# The tdd record at 297 cites a red that does not cover a third of its own slice

F84's second half is about evidence I wrote, so it is recorded here rather than argued with.

The slice at record 297 names three findings, F78, F79 and F80, and cites record 293 as its RED.
Record 293's only failure is the derived-identifier probe, which is F78's and F80's. Its 123 schema
tests all passed. The test carrying F79's repair, the call to `withdrawnShapeClaimsStillStanding`
with no relation, is the 124th: it did not exist when 293 ran and it was green on its first run.
So the record cites, for one of its three findings, a RED that proves nothing about it.

**The gate could not have caught this and that is the point.** It orders `previous_green < red <
green <= regression` and reads the exit codes; it cannot ask whether a red's failures cover the
behaviours the slice claims. Only a reader comparing the two can, which is exactly what the triage
hands the reviewer as the remainder of `red_before_green`, and this is that check finding something.

**It is the same error as the F67 boundary test one round earlier, and I did not learn it then.**
There the implementer told me plainly that the second half of its slice had gone green on its first
run because it characterised behaviour that already held, and said so rather than manufacturing a
failure. That was right, and the honest record would have said which half had a red and which did
not. Instead the slice's `behaviour` field listed everything the round changed and its
`failure_reason` quoted the one assertion that failed, which reads as though the reason covers the
behaviour. Two rounds, same shape.

What the harness offers for this is one field per slice and one pair per slice, so a round that
repairs three findings of which two share a red cannot say so structurally. What it can do is say it
in the prose it already carries: name in `behaviour` which part the cited red covers and which part
had none, and why. That costs nothing and is what the next tdd record on this ticket will do.

Not corrected in place, because record 297 is in the chain and a journal that can be edited after a
reviewer has read it is not evidence. The inaccuracy stands, this record stands beside it, and the
Outcome will carry it.
